title: PostgreSQL: the gateway doesn't create the slot, and create refuses an empty slot name
symptom: Pipeline create: "PostgreSQL slot name cannot be empty or null". With a named slot absent: CDC_NOT_ENABLED, "Logical replication slot <slot> doesn't exist with pgoutput plugin". No slot appeared after two gateway runs.
cause: Not established whether automatic creation is intended.
effect: The first update can't start until the slot exists.
fix: Create the slot by hand (pg_create_logical_replication_slot with pgoutput) before the first update.
notes: The no-name path couldn't be run, because create refuses it.
